groups.title: Move from words
groups.does: Describe a motion. It lands on a World Kit character as a clip you can play, export or shoot in Virtual Set.

groups.title: Follow a performance
groups.does: One picture of a person and one clip of someone moving: the person in the picture does what the clip does.

groups.title: Animate a portrait
groups.does: A still face takes its expressions and head turns from a clip of another face.

groups.title: Lip-sync to audio
groups.does: A clip and a speech track: the mouth is redrawn to the words.

groups.title: Capture into a rig
groups.does: A clip of someone moving becomes motion data for your rigged characters.

groups.title: Dance
groups.does: A dance from words on a character, or a person dancing to a track.

routes.label: Kimodo SOMA
routes.licence: NVIDIA Open Model License; its Llama 3 text encoder is under the Llama 3 Community License
routes.does: Text to a 77-joint body motion, fitted to a World Kit rig from joint positions.

samples.title: Words on Ines, an invented character
samples.prompt: a person walks forward, stops, and waves with the right hand
samples.alt: A woman with a silver bob in a dark blue suit walks forward and raises her right arm in a wave.

weak: Trouser legs can web together at a long stride: cloth is skinned to the legs, not simulated.
Feet stay flat and only turn: no heel-to-toe.
It does what the words say only some of the time: seed 7 on these words walked and never waved, so it was rejected. Try two seeds.
Text encoding on the CPU takes about 16 GB of RAM.
routes.proof: Rendered here, looked at frame by frame

routes.label: Kimodo dance
routes.licence: NVIDIA Open Model License; its Llama 3 text encoder is under the Llama 3 Community License
routes.does: The same model asked for a dance. It does not hear music: the steps are not on the beat.

samples.title: A dance on Tomas, an invented character
samples.prompt: a person dances happily, stepping side to side and swinging their arms
samples.alt: A bearded man in a sand-coloured coat dances with bent knees, arms swinging out, on a marked floor.

weak: It does not hear music, so the steps are not on any beat.
Feet stay flat and only turn: no heel-to-toe.
The long coat stretches at the hips; cloth is skinned to the legs, not simulated.
Seed 21 on the same words came out twice as jittery and was rejected.
routes.proof: Rendered here, looked at frame by frame

routes.label: Wan Animate 2

routes.does: Character replacement in a driving clip, with segmentation by SAM 3.1.

samples.alt: A bearded man in a long coat waves with one hand and gestures with both.

routes.label: LivePortrait
routes.licence: LivePortrait is MIT. Its face finder here is InsightFace buffalo_l, whose weights are for non-commercial use
routes.does: A still face follows the expressions and head turns of a driving clip. Face only: the body stays put.

samples.title: An invented man follows an invented woman's clip
samples.prompt: Both people were made here. The driving clip was made with Wan 2.2.
samples.alt: A bearded man in a scarf turns his head, smiles and tilts as the driving clip does.

weak: Only the head moves: the shoulders and coat stay still, and a big head turn pulls the edge of the hair and scarf.
It copies expressions, it does not hear speech.
Its driving clip must show one clear face from the front.

routes.label: LatentSync 1.6
routes.licence: Code Apache-2.0, weights OpenRAIL++. Its face finder is InsightFace buffalo_l, whose weights are for non-commercial use
routes.does: Redraws the mouth of an existing clip to a speech track, 25 frames a second.

samples.title: An invented woman speaks a made-up line
samples.prompt: The clip was made with Wan 2.2 and the voice with Kokoro-82M's built-in voice bf_emma. Before lip-sync, mouth and voice matched at -0.02 at no lag; after, 0.35.
samples.alt: A woman in a dark coat speaks to the camera, turning her head.

weak: The lower face comes out a little softer than the rest of the frame.
A thick beard blurs: we rejected a bearded test for that.
It redraws the mouth only: the head keeps whatever the clip was doing.
routes.proof: Rendered here, looked at frame by frame, sync measured

routes.label: InfiniteTalk
routes.does: One picture and a speech track: a new clip of that person talking, with head and shoulders moving.

routes.label: SAM 3D Body capture
routes.does: Each frame of a clip gives a body pose. The poses are smoothed and written as a BVH with a film of the fitted body over the clip.

routes.label: Wan Dancer
routes.does: A person from one picture dancing to a music track.

not_offered.why: NVIDIA R&D licence: non-production, no works for sale or distribution. The weights' config is also missing here.
G1 gives a Unitree robot's joints, with no rig here to show them on. SEED is the same kind of body as SOMA and has not been compared with it.
It compares text with motion; it makes nothing to look at.
General clip makers, not motion transfer: they are on the Families page.
Withdrawn: it gave broken poses at the model's own guidance. Its licence also excludes the EU, UK and South Korea.
Non-commercial twice over (its source and the SMPL-X body model).
CC BY-NC-SA, whatever its mirror says, and its detector and frame files are missing here.
Two of its checkpoints (gem_soma, mhr_model) are not on this machine yet. Its terms ask for consent from anyone captured and forbid impersonation.
The model itself is not on this machine. Its parts are research-only or AGPL.

not_offered.model: FlashPortrait, OmniAvatar, StableAvatar, LongCat Avatar, Lynx, MuseTalk, MultiTalk
not_offered.why: Base weights or their packs' dependencies are missing here, so nothing has been rendered with them.

ask: Confirm that the person shown is invented, or has given you permission to use their face, voice and body this way.
limits: Words are checked and pictures and clips go through the picture check, which looks for a readable adult face and nothing undressed. Nothing here can tell a real person from an invented one, and it never hears a voice: that part is your word, and it is kept with the result. Results that show a person carry a visible AI-generated mark.

hero.prompt: a person dances happily, stepping side to side and swinging their arms
hero.note: Kimodo, fitted to a World Kit character made here. Text encoder on the CPU, so it fits beside other work on the card.
hero.alt: A bearded man in a sand-coloured coat dances on a marked floor.
